newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus court remands second Russian in stabbing.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus court remands second Russian in stabbing.

text.p: A Limassol court on Saturday ordered a second Russian national remanded in custody on suspicion of killing another Russian in a drunken brawl.

Vassilis Akaev, 30, was ordered held for eight days after police told the court the man made a statement saying he fatally stabbed businessman Sergei Malekov during an argument at a party on Thursday.
On Friday the court had remanded in custody for three days Russian national Sergei Asqerov for involvement in the killing.
The incident occurred at a dinner party at the house of another Russian in the southern port city of Limassol.
